title: Factorized hash-bucket View codes for logical specialists
task: Four conditional specialists keyed by label mod 4, class-masked expert logits and shared linear router; 64→128 ReLU→10
hypothesis: A shared rank-4 bucket-space basis with four small expert coefficient vectors can produce four useful specialist functions from one shared 2,048-bucket HashedNet table, exceeding tied/salted hash quality by ≥1pp at ≤1.05x salted bytes and matching or beating a native low-rank dense residual control.
physical_object: One shared 2,048-value hash table, shared expert output layer, and shared router
mirror_coordinate: Four expert-specific rank-4 coefficients over one learned rank-4 vector basis in hash-bucket space. Effective bucket vector e = theta + U @ c_e. Hash map/sign is shared and deterministic.
controls: shared hash plus per-expert dense rank-4 matrix residual
shared hash plus per-expert diagonal gate

training.initialization: expert code coefficients zero; shared bases normal std 0.01; other parameters matched by frozen code

development.selection: No tuning grid; all architecture/optimizer/gates fixed before training.

fresh.open_rule: Only if both dev seeds meet every quality, useful-expert, byte, and control gate.

storage.authority: actual serialized inference NPZ bytes after loading and evaluation
storage.deterministic_reconstruction: Shared indices/signs regenerated from paid seed and frozen code.

primary_metrics: router-selected accuracy and cross entropy on finite full-logit task scores
success_gate: Both dev seeds: factorized hash View is ≥1pp above tied and salted controls; within 2pp of independent dense experts; all expert oracle accuracy ≥0.80 and router use ≥10%; payload ≤1.05x salted; no diagonal or dense rank-4 residual control matches/beats within 1pp at ≤1.10x View bytes.
failure_gate: Any dev gate miss or a native/simple control matching View quality is FAIL; fresh remains sealed.
known_metric_guard: For end-to-end selected CE, evaluate full expert logits with a -1e9 group mask and then scatter only the selected expert's allowed class logits into a common 10-class tensor. Never compute CE after filling all non-selected classes with -1e9 without preserving other experts' logits. Oracle CE is separately on each true group's allowed classes.
boundaries: Small digits conditional-specialist screen, not language-model capacity
Logical expert count alone is not capacity
Fixed updates are not near-convergence evidence
Rank-4 coefficient composition must beat native salted and low-rank controls to support Mirror-specific attribution
